subject: No-train & KMS/HSM key residency for APAC tenants - implementation plan
messages:
From: Sumit Patel <sumit.patel@hearthhealth.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: HearthHealth Security <security@hearthhealth.com>
Date: 2027-10-11T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: No-train & KMS/HSM key residency for APAC tenants

Hi Priyom,

Quick question from our security team — we're close to finalizing the DPA addendum and need confirmation about two items before we sign:

1) No-train / no-learning commitment: we need tenant-level assurance that data from our accounts will not be used to improve models or be included in training datasets. Can you confirm whether this is a tenant-configurable flag, and what evidence you provide?

2) Key residency / HSM: for APAC compliance we want customer-managed keys or a guaranteed HSM-backed KMS that stays in APAC region. Specifically: will the KM operations, key rotations, and any key material for encryption-at-rest live in APAC (Singapore) and be under our customer-managed KMS? Also, will any subprocessor transfers require re-attestation in the APAC region?

We'd appreciate a short implementation timeline and the list of artifacts you'll provide (audit logs, attestation statements, config diffs). Attachments are fine.

Thanks,
Sumit
Senior InfoSec Ops
HearthHealth

From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Sumit Patel <sumit.patel@hearthhealth.com>

Date: 2027-10-11T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: No-train & KMS/HSM key residency for APAC tenants

Sumit — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Dev (runtime) and Mina (security PM) to propose a concrete plan and evidence pack.

High level answer up front: yes, we support a tenant-level "no-learn" configuration and can provide an evidence pack including audit logs and a signed attestation. For keys, we support customer-managed KMS (CMK) and HSM-backed solutions in supported regions; we'll map the APAC region options and constraints.

Next: Dev/Mina — can you put together a short runbook with the following by EOD tomorrow?
- Implementation steps for tenant-level no-learn flag (API, Console, and tenant metadata)
- Evidence artifacts (audit log slices, attestation template, export manifest)
- KMS/HSM residency options and required customer actions (CMK setup, grant flows, rotation cadence)
- Any subprocessor handoff / re-attestation requirements when bridging regions

Sumit — I'll be primary contact and will send a timeline + DocuSign link for the DPA addendum once we have the runbook. Attaching our internal checklist to speed review.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-10-12T11:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: No-train & KMS/HSM key residency for APAC tenants — proposed runbook

On Mon, Oct 11, 2027 at 09:05 AM priyom.das@redwood.com wrote:
> Sumit — thanks for the clear ask. Looping in Dev (runtime) and Mina (security PM) to propose a concrete plan and evidence pack.

Team — draft plan below (high level). I'll create a short ops-runbook and a migration playbook for the APAC case.

High level technical approach (tenant-level, minimal infra changes):
- No-learn flag: add tenant metadata key "no_learn": true. Enforcement points:
  * Ingress: strip training telemetry from tenant logs and mark requests as non-trainable in the request header.
  * Serving runtime: runtime checks tenant metadata and disables any telemetry pipelines that feed model-improvement workflows.
  * KV/Prefix cache: ephemeral caches remain but never feed into offline corpora.
- Evidence pack delivered:
  * Timeboxed audit log extract (ISO range) showing disabled pipelines.
  * Signed attestation (PDF) from Redwood Security team.
  * Config diff (kms-config-diff.md) showing tenant flags and policies.
- KMS/HSM residency options:
  * Option A — Customer-managed CMK in APAC (preferred): customer provisions KMS/HSM (AWS KMS with CloudHSM or GCP CMEK with HSM) and grants Redwood a usage-only IAM role; key material never leaves APAC. Requirements: customer must create grants and rotate keys per their policy; Redwood will document the exact IAM/grant steps.
  * Option B — Redwood-managed HSM in APAC dedicated pool: Redwood provisions HSM-backed keys in APAC, with strict subprocessor attestation and monthly key rotation visible in audit logs. Suitable for customers that cannot operate CMK.
- Subprocessor transfers & re-attestation: any transfer of processing to a new subprocessor outside APAC will trigger an automatic re-attestation request and a pause on new data ingestion for tenants flagged "no_learn" until the re-attestation is completed. We'll surface this as a policy in the DPA addendum.

Timeline (estimate):
- Day 0-2: finalize runbook + attestation template (Dev/Mina)
- Day 3-7: customer's KMS grant steps / setup (parallel)
- Day 8-10: smoke test with a staging tenant, generate evidence set
- Day 11: deliver evidence pack and DocuSign link for addendum

Risks / notes:
- Cross-region service failover: in the rare case of APAC outage we may route to a compatible region; for "no_learn" tenants we'll ensure failover does not enable training pipelines and that ephemeral caches are purged.
- Export paths: SFTP export of tenant logs will be available; we'll provide a signed manifest.

I'll attach a draft ops runbook and the KMS config diff.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Staff Engineer, Inference Runtime | Redwood Inference

Attachments: kms-config-diff.md, ops-runbook-sprint.xlsx

Date: 2027-10-14T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: No-train & KMS/HSM key residency for APAC tenants — delivery plan and next steps

Sumit — attaching the plan and confirming next steps. Short summary for your legal/security teams: 

1) No-learn: Redwood will expose a tenant-level "no_learn" flag (API + Console). When enabled, all downstream model-improvement workflows are disabled for that tenant and a timeboxed audit log slice will be delivered as evidence. We will provide a signed attestation (Security Team) that the tenant was configured as no_learn during the evidence window.

2) KMS/HSM residency: two supported options — customer-managed CMK (recommended) or Redwood-managed HSM in APAC. For CMK, key material remains in APAC and Redwood receives a usage-only grant. We will provide the exact grant steps and an integration test plan for the customer's security team.

3) Subprocessor transfers: any change that would move processing outside APAC or to a new subprocessor triggers a re-attestation workflow; ingestion for no_learn tenants is held until re-attestation completes. This will be written into the addendum.

Timeline: we can deliver the runbook + attestation template by 2027-10-15, customer KMS steps can be completed in parallel (estimated 3–7 days), and we aim to provide the evidence pack and DocuSign link by 2027-10-20.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC-HEARTH-2027 (will be live once runbook is finalized)
Drive (evidence folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-HearthHealth-evidence

If this timeline works I'll schedule a 30-minute run-through with your security team and our runtime/security owners tomorrow.

Best,
